scope: Partial local session history associated with the owner's projects; not lifetime usage across all repositories
metric: One unique session or indexed chat classified by its last recorded model; percentages computed separately per tool

codex.source: Read-only local thread index; chat IDs including subagent chats

claude.source: Local assistant JSONL records, grouped by sessionId; last real assistant model observed within each session
claude.excluded: Synthetic models and API error messages; histories not attributable to an owned project

percentage_formula: sessions classified to model / tool's identified sessions * 100, rounded to two decimals
limitations: Not lifetime usage across all repositories
Does not reconstruct model changes within a session
Not code authorship, turns, tokens, time or cost
Separate tool denominators; percentages are not a cross-provider usage comparison
Missing histories are unrepresented, not assigned zero usage
Gemini, ChatGPT and application API calls are not measured
Rounded percentages may not sum exactly to 100
Manual dated snapshot; no automatic refresh configured
privacy: Aggregates only; no project names, repository URLs, prompts, conversations, credentials, local paths or session identifiers
